title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity
reasoning: The paper evaluates political alignment and sycophancy in LLMs, specifically testing their adherence to 'moral anchors' (such as unambiguous condemnation of Nazism) when interacting with users who express sympathetic views. It also evaluates model stances on contentious moral and political issues like abortion.
